title: The AI service is down
story: The AI that compares ShopBot's cart with Asha's request is switched off for this run. The check comes back unsure, so the Guard asks Asha instead of guessing. Nothing stops working, and nothing gets less safe.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order snacks for the party, up to INR 3,000.

steps.instruction: Order snacks for the party, up to INR 3,000.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: I've found party snacks at FreshMart for INR 3,000. Getting the cart checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Asking AgentPay Guard before I pay.

what_to_notice: INTENT_UNKNOWN is the AI outage: no model was called, and an unsure check never counts as a yes. MERCHANT_NEW is here because this run's Asha hasn't paid FreshMart before. The Decision was still made at once.
